ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: MomentoVino uses the camera so you can scan the label on a wine bottle. The app reads the label to identify the wine and add it to your collection.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MomentoVino uses your photo library so you can choose existing wine label photos when scanning a bottle, add pictures to your tasting moments, set your profile photo, and pick a family cover image.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow MomentoVino to use your location to tag where you tasted this wine.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow MomentoVino to access your location
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Allow MomentoVino to access your location
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow MomentoVino to access your microphone
